# Meta-grant denied
`mgr-comms` has `grant_use` for `telegram.send` but no `meta_grant`. An issuance request with `downstream_rights: [grant_use]` fails `403 meta_grant_exceeds_authority`, writes no child grant, and records a denial audit row. A separate request with downstream rights `[use]` may succeed. Grant-use is never upgraded into authority to mint grantors.
